sources.observation: Official map feature FID 772 / SOFM identifies Phi Mu at 201 Waldron St; Shape__Area=1385.22265625 m² and Shape__Length=213.23828916727575 m. NUM_LEVELS=1 and Extrution=12 retained as attributes without assumed field conventions.
sources.uncertainty: Campus GIS is not a certified survey and publishes no positional accuracy or field definitions for NUM_LEVELS/Extrution.

sources.provider: Purdue University Debris yearbook, eArchives CONTENTdm
sources.measurement_method: Contemporary black-and-white yearbook photograph/caption; no dimensions measured.
sources.observation: Phi Mu page includes a photograph of its chapter house and homecoming decoration. The image visibly shows a red-brick, two-main-story house with a broad central white columned portico, white shutters and several dormers on a steep dark roof. This is the most specific architectural source found.
sources.uncertainty: Photograph is oblique and not georeferenced; exact facade dimensions, current alterations and compass bearing are unknown.

sources.measurement_method: Finding-aid record only; no image or dimensions inferred.
sources.observation: The finding aid records a glass negative titled Phi Mu Sorority house at Purdue University dated October 14, 1929, corroborating long-standing house use.
sources.uncertainty: The catalog entry does not identify the street address or show the negative image; identity with the present GIS house is not independently established.
